question_vi: Deep linking config trong RN — setup ra sao?
question_en: How do you configure deep linking in RN?
answer_vi:
Deep link cho phép URL bên ngoài (web link, push notification) mở thẳng vào một screen cụ thể trong app.

**Bước 1 — Khai báo URL scheme:**
- iOS: `Info.plist` thêm `CFBundleURLTypes` với scheme custom (`myapp://`).
- Android: `AndroidManifest.xml` thêm `<intent-filter>` cho `android.intent.action.VIEW` + `<data android:scheme="myapp" />`.
- Universal Link / App Link (recommend): dùng URL HTTPS thật (`https://example.com/...`) thay vì scheme custom — cần config Apple App Site Association và Android Asset Links file.

**Bước 2 — Cấu hình react-navigation:**
```tsx
const linking = {
  prefixes: ['myapp://', 'https://example.com'],
  config: {
    screens: {
      HomeTab: { screens: { Detail: 'product/:id' } },
    },
  },
}
<NavigationContainer linking={linking}>...</NavigationContainer>
```

Link `https://example.com/product/42` → mở `Detail` screen với `route.params.id === '42'`.

**Bước 3 — Test:**
- iOS simulator: `xcrun simctl openurl booted "myapp://product/42"`.
- Android: `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "myapp://product/42"`.

**Lưu ý:** Universal Link bị tắt nếu user "long-press → copy" link (hành vi iOS). Test trên device thật, click từ Mail/Notes app
answer_en:
Deep links let an external URL (web link, push notification) open a specific screen inside the app.

**Step 1 — declare a URL scheme:**
- iOS: add `CFBundleURLTypes` to `Info.plist` with a custom scheme (`myapp://`).
- Android: add `<intent-filter>` for `android.intent.action.VIEW` + `<data android:scheme="myapp" />` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
- Universal/App Links (recommended): use real HTTPS URLs (`https://example.com/...`) instead of custom schemes — requires the Apple App Site Association file and the Android Asset Links file.

**Step 2 — configure react-navigation:**
```tsx
const linking = {
  prefixes: ['myapp://', 'https://example.com'],
  config: {
    screens: { HomeTab: { screens: { Detail: 'product/:id' } } },
  },
}
<NavigationContainer linking={linking}>...</NavigationContainer>
```

`https://example.com/product/42` opens the `Detail` screen with `route.params.id === '42'`.

**Step 3 — test:**
- iOS simulator: `xcrun simctl openurl booted "myapp://product/42"`.
- Android: `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "myapp://product/42"`.

**Note:** iOS disables Universal Links if the user long-press-copies the link. Test on a real device by clicking from Mail or Notes
